About.metaDescription: Our mission: making prediction market and sports analysis accessible through AI.
About.title: Our mission
About.paragraph1: Polymarket, and prediction markets in general, rest on a simple idea: turning a question about the future into a price, set by supply and demand. Understanding that price — and forming your own view on it — means reading resolution rules, cross-checking sources, and staying clear-headed about your own biases. It's more work than most people have time to do properly for every market they care about.
About.paragraph2: Polypips grew out of that observation: giving everyone access to methodical, honest analysis, built by an AI that applies the same rigor to every market, whether it's a Polymarket event or a sports match. Our goal isn't to predict the future for you, but to help you form a more informed opinion, faster.
About.paragraph3: That comes with a commitment we take seriously: never present an estimate as a certainty, never promise a win, and build tools — like simulated Copy Trading — that let you test an approach without ever exposing you to a risk you didn't choose for yourself.

values.aiDescription: Not an oracle, not a sure thing: a tool that processes the available information and explains it clearly, so the final call is always yours.
values.noPromiseDescription: We never claim to guarantee an outcome. Every analysis remains an estimate, never a certainty.
values.simplicityDescription: One plan, no hidden tiers, and explanations in plain language instead of jargon.
